subject.title: feat(auto-reply): add "commentary" verbose level for narration-only progress

question: Should OpenClaw permanently expose narration-only progress as a globally persisted `commentary` verbose level, including suppression of tool-class operational notices and failure detail?
rationale: Source review can verify the implementation, but it cannot authorize a new long-lived config/session contract or decide whether channel-specific commentary controls should remain the preferred boundary.

options.title: Sponsor global preset
options.body: Adopt `commentary` as the canonical cross-channel mode after correcting the downgrade contract and rebasing for exact-head review.

options.title: Keep it session-only
options.body: Retain the command/session behavior but remove agent-default config support to narrow the persisted compatibility surface.

options.title: Keep channel controls
options.body: Decline the global preset and continue separating commentary through channel streaming configuration.

recommendation.title: Sponsor global preset
recommendation.body: Adopt `commentary` as the canonical cross-channel mode after correcting the downgrade contract and rebasing for exact-head review.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored related product-direction work and are connected to the most recent merged commentary behavior, making them the best available owner for the contract choice.
